title: RFC 8887 @type:Request injection in send_request: spec compliance fix absent from reference impl
description: send_request serializes JmapRequest then mutates the JSON object to inject '@type':'Request' before transmission. RFC 8887 §4.3.2 mandates this field in every outgoing WebSocket request frame. The base JmapRequest struct does not carry it (it is HTTP-only and WebSocket-only fields differ). The reference implementation omitted this injection. A contributor might suggest removing the post-serialization mutation as 'ugly' or propose adding @type to JmapRequest itself (which would incorrectly pollute the HTTP path). The current approach — inject only in the WS send path — is the correct, minimal fix. The test send_request_includes_at_type_request verifies it.
